description.en: A fossil branch preserves attached seed cones and conifer foliage.
description.zh: 化石枝保存相连种子球果及针叶树叶。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Voltzia heterophylla, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Voltzia heterophylla 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Documented reproductive branch architecture is an independently useful specimen, not another generic conifer tree.
distinctness.zh: 有记录的生殖枝结构是独立有用的标本，而非另一棵普通针叶树。

modeling_brief.en: Use a compact branch-and-cone arrangement tied to one plate; preserve scale outline without recreating a modern pine cone.
modeling_brief.zh: 依据单一图版布置紧凑球果枝，保留鳞片轮廓，不套用现代松果。

assets.uncertainty: Whole tree shape is not known from the cone study; leaf heteromorphy needs specimen matching.

sources.supports: Triassic Voltzia seed cones, including attached specimens.

description.en: A fossil branch bears whorls of long linear cladodes resembling umbrella spokes.
description.zh: 化石枝轮生细长叶状枝，如伞骨放射。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Sciadopitys, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Sciadopitys 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Discrete umbrella whorls differ from the existing conifer's distributed narrow sprays; these are not pine needle fascicles.
distinctness.zh: 离散伞状轮区别于现有针叶树沿枝窄叶簇，并非松针束。

modeling_brief.en: Use a short axis with several radial blade whorls and shallow central grooves; omit a speculative whole crown.
modeling_brief.zh: 用短轴、数层放射带片和浅中央槽建形，不推测整冠。

assets.uncertainty: Neogene whorled branch evidence is historical cf. material; review the exact specimen and name.

sources.supports: Fossil Sciadopitys cf. marcodurensis leafed branches with whorled linear cladodes.

description.en: A conifer reconstruction uses broad entire leaves rather than needle sprays.
description.zh: 针叶树重建使用宽全缘叶，而非针形叶簇。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Agathis zamunerae; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Agathis zamunerae 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Large simple leaf blades on woody branches give a genuinely broadleaf silhouette absent from the existing conifer.
distinctness.zh: 木质枝上的宽单叶形成现有针叶树没有的真正阔叶轮廓。

modeling_brief.en: Use a restrained spreading trunk framework and thick faceted leaf blades; derive reproductive details from the same fossil taxon.
modeling_brief.zh: 用简约开展树架和厚折面叶建形，生殖细节来自同一化石分类群。

assets.uncertainty: Tree stature and canopy are partly inferred from living Agathis; fossil organs are more secure.

sources.title: First South American Agathis, Eocene of Patagonia
sources.supports: Agathis zamunerae broad leaves, shoots and reproductive organs.

description.en: Slender axes bear finely divided foliage and elongated reproductive shoots without a showy floral cup.
description.zh: 细轴带细裂叶和延长生殖枝，不具显著花被杯。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Archaefructus; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Archaefructus 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Dissected leaf fans and linear reproductive axes differ from lotus discs and paired floating fern leaves.
distinctness.zh: 细裂叶扇及线状生殖轴区别于莲叶盘和成对水蕨浮叶。

modeling_brief.en: Keep the reproductive axis open with small paired units; do not add conventional petals or a modern water-lily flower.
modeling_brief.zh: 保持生殖轴疏开并带小型成对单元，不添加常规花瓣或现代睡莲花。

assets.uncertainty: Aquatic habit and phylogenetic placement are debated; choose one published organismal interpretation.
